Name: Kore, Son of Imnah
Summary: Kore, son of Imnah the Levite and porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, distributing the oblations of the LORD and the most holy things.
KeyStory: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings to distribute them.
RelatedPeople: Imnah, Father of Kore; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: A gatekeeper's faithfulness extended to distributing God's gifts.
